title: Eagle Corp Hits 961.6 Tokens per Second With New EAGLE-4 Accelerator
summary:
Eagle Corp has released a new open source tool designed to accelerate the generation speeds of large language models. The system, called EAGLE-4, achieved a processing rate of 961.6 tokens per second while running an Alibaba Qwen3.8-27B model on four NVIDIA B300 GPUs using TokenSpeed. It employs a speculative decoding strategy that adapts to hardware, workload, and batch size to maintain the target model's output distribution.

The accelerator is available on GitHub as eagle_harness and includes engine plugins for vLLM, SGLang, and TokenSpeed. Eagle Corp also published a research paper and a corresponding draft model for Qwen3.8-27B on HuggingFace. This release is the fastest version in the company's series, succeeding earlier iterations EAGLE-1 through EAGLE-3.
